beats.event: Called to certify wealthy Mrs. Ferrars's suicide
Sister Caroline suspects Ferrars poisoned her husband
Ackroyd invites him to dinner to discuss something urgent
Ackroyd says Ferrars confessed and named a blackmailer
Leaves before Ackroyd opens Ferrars's damning letter
Called back; Parker reports Ackroyd is dead
Helps break down the door to Ackroyd's study
Ackroyd found stabbed; the incriminating letter missing
Stepson Ralph Paton disappears and becomes prime suspect
Flora asks the retired Poirot to investigate
Poirot invites Sheppard along as his companion
Poirot uncovers Ralph's secret marriage to Ursula
Poirot reveals Sheppard is the blackmailer and killer
Told the police will be informed in the morning
Left alone to take his own life
